title: I Made $10K Last Month From a Skill I Learned in 3 Months (Here's How)
audience: Ambitious 18-28 year olds, figuring out careers and finances
tone: High energy, direct, trend-aware, hype best friend energy

concept.hook: I spent $0 on a course and made $10K in my fourth month using one skill I learned for free on YouTube.

📌 What you'll learn:
- How to identify profitable skills without paying for courses
- The free learning stack: YouTube + Reddit + Notion
- How to sell before you're ready and build a portfolio fast
- The hidden job market and how DMs access it

💬 Drop 'START' in the comments — I'll DM you the exact cold DM template.

visual_scene: A stylish modern coffee shop with warm amber lighting, exposed brick walls, and floor-to-ceiling windows letting in golden afternoon light. A young ambitious person in their early 20s sits at a corner table with an open laptop and an iced coffee, staring at their phone screen with a shocked expression — eyes widening, a slow smile spreading across their face, hand rising to cover their mouth in disbelief as a payment notification glows on the screen. The background shows other customers working on laptops, blurred to keep focus on the subject. Later shots show the same person typing confidently at the laptop, standing and gesturing directly to camera with high energy, all set in the same warm coffee shop atmosphere. Cinematic portrait 9:16 vertical framing, empowering and aspirational mood.
specific_details: A young ambitious person in their early-mid 20s with stylish casual attire sitting at a modern coffee shop corner table, open laptop displaying a spreadsheet or portfolio, iced coffee beside them, staring at a phone screen showing a glowing payment notification with a shocked and delighted expression — eyes wide, slow smile, hand over mouth. Later shots: confident direct-to-camera address with hand gestures pointing at viewer, eye contact, high energy. Warm amber coffee shop lighting, blurred background of other patrons, portrait 9:16 framing throughout.
